first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The broad-built, bald person in the left foreground, facing away from the camera, with broad red markings on the head, neck, and bare shoulders, wearing brown leather protective gear.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: The short-haired person in the right middle ground, seated astride Animal A's back, wearing a light gray-blue top and dark pants.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: The large gray-brown quadruped in the right middle ground, with thick curved horns, blue eyes, and golden armor on its head and back, carrying Person C on its back.

entities.name: Dark Red Tree Canopy
entities.identification: The dark red and pink clusters of leaves and dark branches at the top and upper left of the image.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The spear extending diagonally along the image-right side of Person A, with a narrow silver tip pointing toward the upper right and a long dark red cloth hanging from the shaft.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: The long-handled axe on Person A's back near the image-right side, with a broad silver-gray axe head and a long brown handle.

entities.name: Weapon C
entities.identification: The exposed upper section and diagonal thin string of the bow behind Person A's head and shoulders; the bow has alternating dark and light patterns.

entities.name: Stone-Framed Wooden-Stake Gate
entities.identification: The green-gray gate frame and vertical row of orange-brown pointed wooden stakes in the left background, partially occluded by Person A.

entities.name: Gray Stone Wall
entities.identification: The gray stone facade in the central to right background, with a deep, dark opening in the center and much of its surface covered by roots and vines.

entities.name: Gnarled Vines on the Wall
entities.identification: The thick gray-brown roots, thin vines, and attached clusters of green leaves covering the wall.

entities.name: Courtyard Stone-Paved Ground
entities.identification: The irregular blue-gray-green stone slabs and rubble in the lower part of the image, crossed by slender red-brown strips in the middle ground.

entities.name: Ground Moss
entities.identification: The green clumps of grass, low moss-like cover, and a small number of broad leaves in the stone gaps and on the middle-ground surface.

entities.name: Courtyard Fungal Clusters
entities.identification: The clusters of red-orange umbrella-shaped fungi on the ground, with small yellow-green caps beside some clusters.

entities.name: Weapon D
entities.identification: The long silver-gray curved blade extending diagonally across Person A's back, with its upper end near the back of the neck and a dark brown grip.
